title: LaterDiscs
description: Adds Music Discs from later Minecraft versions and recipes for them and vanilla discs to Minecraft.
body:
ExtraDiscs - Forge adds Music Discs from later versions to previous versions of Minecraft.

The mod also adds stonecutter recipes to both these new Music Discs and the vanilla Music Discs.

The Blank Music Discs is stonecuttable into any Music Disc in vanilla Minecraft and the Discs ExtraDiscs adds.
